'''Zaadja''' was an icy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with snowy plains surrounded by impervious mountains.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], working for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], established a hive factory-fortress on the planet. At that time, the factory was littered with [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] corpses.

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a [[Republic Army]], led by [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tohno]], was sent to the planet in order to destroy the Separatists' factory. Tohno gave her life to blow up the hive factory: a sacrifice that made the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle of Zaadja|victorous]].

[[Jodo Kast]] managed to salvage some Mandalorian armor from this planet which he then used to impersonate [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] as a bounty hunter.<ref name="HM" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]'' initially identified '''Zaddja''' and '''Zaadja''' as the same planet. More recently, ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' treats them as different planets, with each receiving an entry in the encyclopedia. ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' adds further confusion to the situation by erroneously labeling the image of Zaddja as Zaadja.
